title: Thermodynamics-Informed Learning Captures Hierarchical Hydrogen-Bond Networks in Deep Eutectic Solvents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) offer a tunable platform for lignocellulose refining, but their solvation behavior depends on multicomponent hydrogen-bond networks rather than individual constituent properties. We develop TiNN, a thermodynamics-informed neural network that hierarchically represents HBA-HBD association and solute accommodation through a learned free-energy pathway. Trained on 938 records, TiNN achieves a test-set $R^2$ of 0.917 and generalizes to new HBA-HBD combinations and sparse conditions. Ablation identifies solute-specific stabilization as the largest contributor to prediction accuracy, while the importance of hydrogen-bond compatibility depends on the dissolution mechanism. Experimental measurements of glucose, xylan, and Kraft lignin in acidic, basic, and neutral DESs show that TiNN reduces the geometric mean solubility error from more than 23-fold with COSMO-RS to approximately 1.5-fold. Without training on fractio

translated_title: 热力学信息引导的学习捕捉低共熔溶剂中的分层氢键网络
translated_abstract: 低共熔溶剂为木质纤维素精炼提供了一个可调节的平台，但其溶剂化行为取决于多组分氢键网络，而非各组分的单独性质。我们开发了TiNN，一种热力学信息引导的神经网络，通过学习到的自由能路径分层地表征氢键受体-氢键供体的缔合以及溶质的容纳过程。TiNN在938条记录上训练后，测试集R²达到0.917，并能泛化到新的氢键受体-供体组合以及数据稀疏的条件。消融实验表明，溶质特异性稳定化是对预测准确性贡献最大的因素，而氢键相容性的重要性则取决于具体的溶解机制。在酸性、碱性和中性低共熔溶剂中对葡萄糖、木聚糖和硫酸盐木质素的实验测量表明，TiNN将几何平均溶解度误差从COSMO-RS的超过23倍降低至约1.5倍。在无需对分数溶解（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究提出热力学信息引导的神经网络TiNN，通过学习自由能路径分层刻画低共熔溶剂中氢键受体-供体缔合与溶质容纳过程，将木质纤维素溶解度预测误差从COSMO-RS的23倍以上降至约1.5倍。
en_tdlr: The study introduces TiNN, a thermodynamics-informed neural network that hierarchically captures HBA-HBD association and solute accommodation through a learned free-energy pathway, reducing solubility prediction errors for lignocellulose in deep eutectic solvents from over 23-fold with COSMO-RS to about 1.5-fold.
